title: asta schaffneri subsp. stricta
intro: Asta schaffneri subsp. stricta, commonly known as the strict asta, is a plant species that belongs to the family Asteraceae. It is a perennial herb that has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its numerous health benefits. The strict asta has been reported to have anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as reducing inflammation, protecting against oxidative stress, and preventing infections. The bioactive constituents of the strict asta include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are being studied for their potential in treating various health conditions.
